semiconductor_relevance: High — TOFWERK provides advanced mass spectrometry solutions specifically designed for real-time monitoring and analysis in semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: TOFWERK specializes in ultra-sensitive mass spectrometers that enable comprehensive chemical analysis and monitoring in semiconductor manufacturing. Their technologies support critical applications such as ambient air monitoring and process gas analysis, ensuring the purity and composition of materials used in fabrication.
capabilities: Real-time AMC monitoring with Vocus CI-TOF
Sensitive process gas analysis for etch, deposition, and lithography
Advanced AMC visibility with Vocus ABC and VOC Monitors
